fixed_design.type: three-level full factorial plus locked validation

prior_evidence.length_centers: best retained K4/N10 S-grid length in each cell; 23 cells have closed S evidence and two are geometry-limited
prior_evidence.k_range: matched fine-step gains are generally small near K4-K6, but K6 is not independently closed; use K2/4/6 plus conditional K1/7
prior_evidence.n2: 14 retained N2 results are noncompetitive; four fixed-length/fixed-K matches trail N5-N10 by 14.9-17.6 score points; N2 closure only
prior_evidence.n_center: N4/8/16 preserves a full-rank physically distinct model in all 25 cells; N4/10/16 becomes rank-deficient in some cells

execution_policy.factorial_completion_rule: run every feasible, profile-distinct canonical factorial coordinate; linked effects may reverse with mouth, coverage, S, or length
execution_policy.handoff_rule: a completed or geometry-rejected search immediately releases its slot; single-candidate searches use an explicit seed candidate rather than an empty initial pool
execution_policy.axis_closure_rule: run the next outward L, K, or N endpoint only when the measured inner endpoint improves score by at least 0.5 points or provides a material diagnostic improvement over the center; N=2 is only the conditional lower safety-bound probe after N=4 points outward

analysis_policy.primary_confirmatory_dataset: canonical study coordinates plus only strict exact-response reuses; historical optimizer traces do not fill missing canonical contrasts
analysis_policy.augmented_predictive_dataset: after confirmatory analysis, add all solver-compatible historical responses with provenance retained for prediction and transfer checks
analysis_policy.second_stage: map the same within-cell coefficients across mouth and coverage; report replicated signs, magnitudes, and diagnostic tradeoffs
analysis_policy.locked_validation: evaluate interpolation at two preregistered interior points per cell; never use these points to fit, select, or prune
